sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.content: Santa Clara County Tourism asked for an accountable Year 1 partner. We propose a program that separates agency creative fees from client media pass-through so evaluators can see where dollars land.

sections.title: Budget Narrative
sections.content: Year 1 agency revenue (fees) is $95,000.00. Client media pass-through is $180,000.00. Total Year 1 client invoicing is $275,000.00. These figures match the attached budget table and do not invent commission lines without a media base.

sections.title: Commercial Terms
sections.content: Fees are billed monthly against the $95,000.00 agency fee subtotal. Media placements of $180,000.00 are invoiced at cost with documentation. The grand total of $275,000.00 is the sum of those components.
